summary: One-line fix replaces exhausting generator (StopIteration) with next(...,np.nan) fallback, matching expected 3.6.0 behavior for all-nan input; minimal and general, not test-specific.

issues.description: Returning np.nan works for numeric/datetime-like data but callers using non-numeric objects (e.g. custom unit types) may not handle a bare np.nan sentinel gracefully; edge case, not the reported bug.
